title: GET /api/projects — list all user projects
description: Return all non-deleted projects for the authenticated user, including computed progress and summary stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns only projects belonging to the authenticated user
Returns array sorted by updated_at DESC
Each project includes: id, name, type, status, progressAuto, progressManual, pointsTotal, level, isPublic, updatedAt

steps.description: Implement GET / handler on projects router
steps.details: Query: db.select().from(projects).where(and(eq(projects.userId, req.userId), isNull(projects.deletedAt))).orderBy(desc(projects.updatedAt)). Return 200 with the array.
Create 2 projects, then GET /api/projects — verify both returned in descending order. Soft-delete one project, verify it's excluded.

technicalNotes: No pagination needed here — users are unlikely to have hundreds of projects, but add limit=50 as a safety cap
